activation.if_not_satisfied: do not run and do not relax species/photo targets

estimand: cross-species sharing of geographic transition geometry in visible flower colour, beyond species-specific boundaries and beyond matched photographic/background colour geography

future_geometry.source: a separately frozen fresh metadata candidate frame for the 150 post-capacity-selected species

continuous_colour_representation.pairwise_flower_distance: Euclidean distance in the frozen camera-space CIELAB mean vector
continuous_colour_representation.pairwise_background_distance: Euclidean distance in the frozen camera-space CIELAB mean vector

sharedness_statistic.geographic_axis_grid: the same 96 fixed antipodally unique unit-sphere normals generated from seed 202609070801 in sharedness v1
sharedness_statistic.species_axis_score: for each candidate axis and threshold, mean pairwise primary colour contrast among photo pairs on opposite sides minus mean pairwise primary colour contrast among photo pairs on the same side; require both pair classes, otherwise that species-axis-threshold cell is unavailable
sharedness_statistic.species_direction_invariance: the statistic uses colour distances, so red-to-white versus white-to-red or different species-specific CIELAB response directions do not need a shared sign
sharedness_statistic.training: using training species only, convert each species axis score to evidence relative to its equal-weight independent-axis baseline, marginalize the fixed threshold grid, and form a posterior over common geographic axis and sharing fraction
sharedness_statistic.evaluation: score disjoint evaluation species by predictive log-density/evidence gain under the training posterior relative to the independent-axis baseline; evaluation colour labels never update the posterior

synthetic_generator.coordinate_frame: actual future high-depth metadata geometry only
synthetic_generator.species_specific_boundary: independent random unit-sphere normal and independent threshold for every non-sharing species
synthetic_generator.shared_boundary: one common unit-sphere normal assigned to the fixed shared fraction; response direction in CIELAB remains species-specific
synthetic_generator.species_colour_centroid: independent nuisance centroid; cancels from pairwise distances and is retained to test implementation invariance
synthetic_generator.species_colour_response_direction: independent random unit vector in three-dimensional CIELAB-like standardized coordinates
synthetic_generator.flower_response: centroid + amplitude * species_colour_direction * tanh((geographic_projection - species_threshold)/0.15) + multivariate observation noise
synthetic_generator.background_response: independent background centroid plus prespecified photographic/geographic nuisance gradients and multivariate noise; no biological shared flower boundary unless explicitly specified by a nuisance arm
synthetic_generator.matched_photo_nuisance: prespecified per-photo additive three-dimensional nuisance component added to both flower and background vectors
synthetic_generator.structured_null_property: every species may have a strong independent flower boundary; this is null, not positive sharedness

measurement_retention_rule: retention is generated independently from biological sharedness but may include prespecified coordinate-dependent nuisance arms; no single assumed 51-percent historical classifiable rate
calibration_nuisance_families: directionally clustered but nonshared flower boundaries
coordinate-dependent measurement retention without shared flower boundary

calibration.threshold: maximum empirical 97.5th percentile using method=higher across all structured-null calibration families and all fixed measurement-retention arms
calibration.decision: strict world score greater than the single frozen global threshold

claim_ceiling: Prospective synthetic qualification of a continuous matched-control, species-disjoint sharedness statistic on future high-depth geometry. Not observed ecological evidence.
